title: Debugging, Assertions, Lint, and Check Mode
objective: Use fast feedback tools and encode runtime assumptions.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.
sourceAlignment.chapterTitle: Testing and CI for Ansible Content

paragraphs: debug reveals selected values, while assert and fail turn assumptions into executable checks. Use verbosity carefully so secrets do not enter CI logs.
yamllint checks YAML, syntax-check parses Ansible, ansible-lint evaluates practices, and check mode previews supported behavior. These layers complement rather than replace runtime tests.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Use fast feedback tools and encode runtime assumptions.
